'''Stefaan Lambrecht''' played constructed lists at [[2012 World Championship]] (Day 2). In 2008 he and [[Kris Van Beurden]] were the European Flight Leaders for Belgium.<ref name="sf-19184-268303">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=268303#p268303 Star Wars: The Road to Europe 2008!  Full Schedule], Michael Erisman (mserisman), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (18 February 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125174755/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t19184.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sf-21361-307954">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=307954#p307954 Star Wars: The Road to Europe 2008! Full Schedule], Advocate, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (17 June 2008).</ref>
